title: Mutation tests for the cloud page-writer key in the pick guard
why: PR #2489's pick-guard change has no mutants for its key read, so a later edit could break it with every test green.
note: From lane pick-guard-cloud-writer (#2489), coordinator 01:52 CST Nov 10. A test-author writes the post-build mutants: swap the precedence; the lane reads the key; drop the fallback; `ran` set on any get. Starts after #2489 merges. The layout extras key is now `page-writer` (not `waiting-page-writer`), after the glossary refused the old name.
